content.text: {"id":"8b0e5aa3-a7bf-4d31-9534-1482d8a9b8dd","audio_id":"ba4e8175-ccf7-4461-8e35-091b0a36112d","status":"complete","created_at":"2026-11-16T04:58:46Z","answer":"The lead is a bright, high-register, childlike-sounding voice with a smooth, polished, slightly synthetic tone and tightly controlled pitch. The delivery has clear, simple melodic rises and falls in the opening and connecting lines, while the repeated “통통통 공 / 빵빵 자동차” hook becomes more clipped and chant-like; that repetition feels intentional and rhythmically phrased rather than a flaw. A steady, buoyant 4/4 pop groove pairs a light kick and crisp claps with a bouncy bass and bright strummed/key-like accompaniment. The hook is more emphatic and percussive than the comparatively flowing opening and linking lines, though the backing remains consistent overall.\n\nThe Korean words are generally intelligible. The repeated syllables are naturally staccato; around 0:48–0:59 the “공아 통통 자동차 빵빵” repetitions are especially tightly packed, but I don’t hear a clearly broken or accidentally chopped word. The lyric recognizer’s final line stops at “놀” around 1:15, which appears to be a missed completion rather than evidence of an audible cutoff: the final phrase sounds like it continues into “놀자.” There is a long instrumental tail after the last vocal, roughly 1:16 to the end at 1:26. The first vocal begins around 0:01.4; the last line begins around 1:12.2, with its final vocal ending approximately 1:15.6. Tempo is 114 BPM, felt as a steady upbeat pulse."}
